ios.NSCameraUsageDescription: SiteMuster uses the camera only to scan orientation and badge QR codes.
ios.NSLocationWhenInUseUsageDescription: SiteMuster uses your location only to estimate when you arrive at and leave the jobsites you joined. It never sends where you are away from a site.
ios.NSLocationAlwaysAndWhenInUseUsageDescrip: Automatic attendance needs "Always" so your phone can notice you arriving at or leaving a jobsite while the app is closed. Away from sites only entering or leaving is noted, never your position.
ios.NSMotionUsageDescription: SiteMuster uses motion only to save battery: it checks your location less often while you stand still on site.
